properties.displayName: UAV S28 - Imagery Stream Lost (Situational Awareness Denial)
properties.description: UAVImagery_CL의 GapMs(프레임 끊김)가 임계치 이상이거나 FrameRate가 비정상적으로 낮아지는 패턴 탐지. 실제 컬럼: GapMs(Int64), FrameRate(Double), FrameCount 없음. MITRE: T0815 Denial of View (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let gapThresholdMs = 5000;
let minFrameRate = 1.0;
UAVImagery_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend isGapAlert = GapMs > gapThresholdMs
| extend isLowFrameRate = FrameRate < minFrameRate and FrameRate > 0
| extend isStreamDown = EventType has_any ("stream_lost", "disconnect", "stopped")
| where isGapAlert or isLowFrameRate or isStreamDown
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isStreamDown, strcat("영상스트림_중단_", EventType),
    isGapAlert, strcat("영상프레임_끊김_", tostring(GapMs), "ms"),
    strcat("영상프레임율_저하_", tostring(round(FrameRate,2)), "fps"))
| extend Severity = "Medium"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, StreamId, GapMs, FrameRate, Resolution, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S28 - Imagery Stream Lost (Situational Awareness Denial) - {{UAVId}}
